answer: Sybil resistance via staked reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond to register, and peers randomly audit a sample of its work each epoch. A fake cluster of identities must fund every bond, so an attacker who would wander across a thousand sock-puppet accounts pays a thousand times the stake, and one failed audit burns it. Honest agents treat the bond as their island, a stable home base, while shared reputation pools act as an oasis where verified peers vouch and slash fraud.
